entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_01

entries.text: 你居然会主动来问候我，\n看来是变机灵了啊？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_00

entries.text: 我也和阿栗\n一起回到学园了。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_01

entries.text: 所以你要是见到我，\n记得要在２秒之内跟我打招呼！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_02

entries.text: 好的！
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 哎哟，还挺坦率的嘛。\n你是吃错药了吗？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_03

entries.text: 嘻嘻！\n你那张嫌弃的脸！\r\n真是太棒啦！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_03b

entries.text: 哎～在北上待了一段时间后，\n现在感觉学园看起来乱哄哄的。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_04

entries.text: 因为翠绿镇\n什～么都没有啊！\r\n……虽说那正是它的优点吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp01_05

entries.text: 我当时……呃……\n咭呗咭呗地跳舞的样子……\r\n你没有拍视频之类的吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_01

entries.text: 没有拍
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 其实……
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 啊～太好了！！\n就算我那时是被操纵了，\r\n但那也是我人生唯一的污点啊！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_02

entries.text: 哈啊～！？不行！！\n现在立刻！！给我删掉！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_02b

entries.text: 要是留下照片之类的，\n等我出名时可就头疼了！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_03

entries.text: 说到底，那个……\n叫桃歹郎的，是宝可梦？\r\n它到底是怎么回事啊？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_04

entries.text: 我想了想，你不觉得它和宝伴\n给人的感觉很像吗？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_05

entries.text: 可能吧！
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_select_03

entries.text: 是吗？
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_select_04

entries.text: 绝对像！！\n说不定它们之间有什么关联！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_06

entries.text: 不过也没法\n直接去问宝可梦……\r\n也就是说，真相无法浮出水面了！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp02_07

entries.text: 你居然会主动来搭话，\n不错呀。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_00

entries.text: 在那之后……\n你和阿栗的关系如何？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_01

entries.text: 关系很好！
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 一般般
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 哦～？\n只要关系不坏就好。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_02b

entries.text: 那孩子现在……\n不论是学园生活，还是社团活动，\r\n方方面面都很努力。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_03

entries.text: 要你支持他……倒是不必。\n至少和之前一样和他好好相处吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_04

entries.text: 当然了！
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_select_03

entries.text: 都听丹瑜你的！
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_select_04

entries.text: 我想也是……\n就算我不说这些，\r\n你们本来也是朋友嘛。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_05

entries.text: 这就对啦！为了我，\n你要好好陪他！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_05b

entries.text: 唉～！可能我也\n有点太溺爱他了吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_06

entries.text: 从今往后我会\n适度地守护阿栗的！\r\n……虽然感觉有点寂寞！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_sp03_07

entries.text: 和你聊天以后，\n总感觉变得有点伤感。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_01_00

entries.text: 你得负起责任来啊。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_01_01

entries.text: 嗯……\n那你就来陪我交换宝可梦吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_01_02

entries.text: 你的态度不错嘛。\n我要用斯魔茶来交换，\r\n你要用什么？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊……
以你来说算是不错的宝可梦呢。\c
我会好好珍惜它的，
你不用担心啦！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_01_04

entries.text: 要用你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和我的斯魔茶交换对吧？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_02_03

entries.text:
只有１只同行宝可梦的话，
是没法交换的，你不知道吗？\c
等你有２只以上同行宝可梦时
再来找我吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_03_00

entries.text: 果然你还是想\n和我交换宝可梦的，对吧？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_trade_04_00

entries.text: 你好像很闲啊。\n我来陪你打一场吧？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_talkto_00

entries.text: 居然拒绝我的邀请，\n你就不怕后悔一辈子吗？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_cancel_00

entries.text: 嘻嘻……那就让我\n来锻炼你一下吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battlestart_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n你怎么只有１只宝可梦啊？\r\n我想打双打对战啦。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battlestart_01

entries.text: ……要是那个招式命中了，\n我想赢的就是我了。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 能让我一败涂地的人\n也就只有你了。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 啊！稍微等一下！\n作为奖励，我把那个给你吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 这个眼镜和你很配哦。\n今后你就一辈子都戴着它吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从丹瑜那里\n获得了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]搞怪眼镜（来悲粗茶）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_reward_00

entries.text: ……你听好了啊。\n是我故意让你赢的，懂吗？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 下次我可不会这样了！\n明白了吧！真是的！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
嘻嘻！这就是
我使出全力的结果。\c
蓝莓联盟冠军的宝座
随时都可以让给我哦。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
你问为什么我
不像阿栗一样有口音？\c
因为我是一位俏佳人！
就这么简单。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 学园和联盟社你都自然地\n融入进去了，真可怕！\r\n感觉你挺适合去当间谍的？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_randomtalk_01

entries.text: 厄诡椪它过得还好吗？\c\n组成夺回面具小队去打倒\n宝伴们的日子真让人怀念啊。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_randomtalk_02

entries.text: 你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]很听话哦。\n我甚至都想叫你向它学习呢！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_randomtalk_03

entries.text: 我的斯魔茶很不错吧？\c\n它可是随时都能为你\n送上热腾腾的茶水呢。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: coach_bb_sister_randomtalk_04
